text:
anna_pm: Quick check — are we green on the joint announcement choreography + tenant onboarding for PartnerX's marketplace listing? Need to confirm press/landing cadence and who owns the customer handoff.

mike_partnerships: PartnerX confirmed GA window: week of May 12. They want coordinated press + marketplace tile. Assets sent last night.

devon_marketing: Got the assets. Press embargo: May 11 09:00 PT. We need final quotes and logo guidelines by EOD Friday. @kevin_legal any issues with the language?

kevin_legal: Skimmed the draft — trademark usage fine but need partner to sign off on the joint statement. I'll ping them and request the signed OK by Friday morning.

luis_sales: On customer onboarding: can we get a dedicated onboarding tenant and 2 demo seats for early adopters? Need handoff doc to Sales + CSMs before launch.

jenna_csm: I can own the handoff doc. Need the onboarding steps and sample creds from engineering. Also want a playbook: triage matrix, known limitations, escalation path.

sasha_engineering: Working on the SI integration checklist. Terraform module is 80% done; validating auth flow with PartnerX tomorrow. For demo tenant, ops needs the region and instance size.

anna_pm: Good. Quick owner list: Marketing (devon) = press + landing; Partnerships (mike) = partner comms; Legal (kevin) = signoff; CSM (jenna) = onboarding; Eng (sasha) = demo tenant + infra. Is that everyone? :thumbsup:

devon_marketing: I'll draft the landing page copy and a short hero blurb. Can someone drop the marketplace listing fields we must populate? screenshots, feature bullets, pricing tier, datasheet link.

mike_partnerships: Partner provided a datasheet link and hero screenshot. I'll upload. Also coordinating a joint blog with PartnerX. Draft due Wed.

sasha_engineering: For the marketplace tile we need these bits from product: supported model versions, max seq length, quantization info, recommended instance types. @anna_pm can you extract?

anna_pm: Yep — I'll pull the matrix and post in the thread by tomorrow AM.

kevin_legal: Reminder: embargo means no public blog or co-announcement until partner signs and we hit the embargo time. Any pre-briefs to press must be on NDA list.

deven (typo correction): sorry, meant devon.

devon_marketing: Re: rehearsal — recommend a pre-launch run-through (content + deploy) on May 9. 30m dry-run for press ops and 30m run for marketplace publish. Who can join?

mike_partnerships: I can do both. @luis_sales will join the customer Q&A rehearsal.

luis_sales: Yep. I'll bring 3 FAQ items from our pipeline: SSO, data residency, and performance SLAs.

jenna_csm: I'll prepare the onboarding checklist. Quick ask: include a sample support-level SLO and preferred contact flow.

sasha_engineering: Ops note — to seed the demo tenant we need a slightly different infra script. Pasting quick snippet for ops:
```
# demo seed script (ops)
terraform apply -var=\"partner=partnerx\" -auto-approve
scripts/seed_demo.sh --tenant partnerx-demo --users 5
```

deploybot: scheduled: marketplace-tile-publish (canary) -> 2026-05-11T16:00:00Z. Triggered by tag release/partnerx-ga.

devon_marketing: Timeline recap in short:
- Fri EOD: final legal quote + logo OK
- Mon May 8: marketing landing draft
- Wed May 10: partner blog draft
- May 9: rehearsal
- May 11 09:00 PT: embargo lifts / press
- May 11 16:00Z: marketplace canary publish

anna_pm: Perfect. Action items:
- @kevin_legal get partner signature by Fri AM
- @sasha_engineering provision demo tenant + seed script run
- @devon_marketing finalize landing + coordinate press list
- @jenna_csm prepare onboarding playbook and handoff doc
- @mike_partnerships confirm partner blog draft due Wed
- @luis_sales compile 3 sales FAQs

mike_partnerships: I'll keep the partner tight on deadlines. If anyone needs the partner's marketing contact, DM me.

jenna_csm: I'll draft the handoff and post a link here when ready.

anna_pm: Thanks all — will follow up with a short checklist doc tomorrow. :eyes:
